summary: The resource module builder is a playbook that scaffolds a role or collection from a YAML model used for docs and argspec, regenerates only argspec and docstring on rerun, and generates sample <os>_<resource> and <os>_facts modules.
questions: What does the resource module builder generate?
Will rerunning the resource module builder overwrite my code?

answer_card.title: Resource module builder
answer_card.answer_md:
An Ansible playbook that treats a YAML model as the source of truth for the module's DOCUMENTATION and argspec. It:
- scaffolds the directory layout and class files (as a role or a collection)
- on later runs, only replaces the argspec and docstring files
- keeps complex examples alongside the model
- generates working samples for `<network_os>_<resource>` and `<network_os>_facts`
